title: Agile-Customer Tech - Salesforce - Sr Developers
description:
Customer Tech - Salesforce Senior Developer 

 The Opportunity 
 We are looking for an experienced and certified Salesforce Developer with a strong focus on Service Cloud to design, develop, and support scalable Salesforce solutions. The ideal candidate will have hands-on development and configuration experience, along with a strong understanding of Salesforce administration and business processes. Experience in Public Sector Solutions will be a significant advantage. 

 Your Key Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, and implement Salesforce solutions with a focus on Service Cloud Develop and maintain Visualforce pages Perform Salesforce administration including org setup, user management, profiles, roles, and security Create custom objects, fields, picklists, page layouts, workflows, approvals, validation rules, and flows Configure and maintain reports and dashboards Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into Salesforce solutions Provide technical support during deployment and post-go-live 

 Skills and attributes for success 
 Experience with Salesforce Public Sector Solutions Familiarity with Omni Studio and Omni Script Strong analytical and communication skills 

 Required Qualifications 
 Salesforce Certified Platform Developer Minimum 5 years of Salesforce development experience with strong Service Cloud expertise Visualforce development experience Strong Salesforce configuration and administration skills
